assertion_audit.fails_when: x64 is not enabled after configure_dtypes; this checks effective configuration.
Continuation uses more updates than the independent direct solve; it is a cost comparison, not a predictor-wiring guard.

Successful steps do not double up to the initial-drive scale, clipping does not use remaining distance, no failed step shrinks, no accepted step grows after rejection, or the requested initial step is ignored.

Return the previous unchanged state, reverse the secant, omit the drive ratio or use the wrong ratio; the expected next state comes from an independently specified slope and drive trajectory; unchanged-seed-mutant.log records this exact failure.
A missing-history or repeated-drive input changes the moments or produces NaN; equality to the input is the fallback contract, not a claimed extrapolation check.

The target is not certified, no target fresh read occurs, terminal tolerance is loosened above the fixed 1e-10, residual exceeds it, or the diagnostic disagrees with the mock fresh-read trace; the last comparison is bookkeeping consistency, not independent proof of physical certification or predictor use.
Restore acceptance based only on the converged flags and ignore a 1e-5 residual; the dishonest solver forces exactly this guarded condition.

x64/backend/import provenance is wrong, the selected saved arrays have the wrong width, or a lane fails certification; the hard-coded width guard enforces the reduced experiment rather than the dispatched width.
An object array reaches the byte digest, preventing pointer-based nondeterministic identity.
The unchanged-seed mutant does not fail its named test, an after arm adds a failure, or either suite arm never completes.

The scheduler/log lacks successful completion, suites or red control lack their expected results, receipts are incomplete or corrupt, inputs differ, lane cardinality is wrong, or terminal/precision values are nonfinite or over budget.
Any of four deliberately over-budget independent candidate arrays is accepted; the reference spans and fixed budget thresholds remain unchanged during each mutation.
